issues.legal_issue: An acquisition may be upheld as a fact-specific disposition of land-acquisition appeals, subject to recalculation and payment of compensation on specified terms, without deciding the legality of the findings under appeal.
material_facts: The appeals concerned acquisitions of the land involved in both cases.
The Court considered the cases to have peculiar facts and found public interest involved.
The High Court had made findings on the legality of the acquisitions, but the Court set those findings aside without deciding that legal question.
The Court directed that compensation be determined as if the acquisitions had been made on 1 March 1988, and required determination and payment within specified periods.
issues.conclusion: The acquisitions were upheld, subject to compensation being determined according to law as if the acquisitions had been made on 1 March 1988, and then paid within the periods directed by the Court.
issues.legal_principle: The Court relied on the peculiar facts and public interest in these appeals to uphold the acquisitions subject to conditions governing compensation, while expressly leaving the legality of the High Court's findings undecided. No statutory provision or earlier case is cited.

rule.if: land_acquisition_appeal and acquisition_already_made and peculiar_case_circumstances and public_interest_involved

predicates.land_acquisition_appeal: The parties brought an appeal concerning a land acquisition.
predicates.acquisition_already_made: The acquisition challenged in the proceeding had already been made.
predicates.peculiar_case_circumstances: The court found the circumstances of the case to be peculiar.
predicates.public_interest_involved: The court found that public interest was involved.
predicates.acquisition_upheld_subject_to_revised_co: The acquisition is upheld subject to compensation being recalculated and paid on specified conditions.

issues.definition: When a land-acquisition appeal concerns an acquisition already made and the court finds peculiar circumstances and public interest, the acquisition is upheld subject to revised compensation and payment conditions.
